chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Hamzah al-Thumali, who said: Nafi' ibn al-Azqar asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: Inform me about Allah, since when has He existed?

He (peace be upon him) replied to him: Woe be upon you! Tell me when He did not exist, so that I can tell you when He did exist. Glory be to Him, who has always been and will always be, the Peerless, the Needless, who has taken neither wife nor son.
ai.seo_question: What is the theological explanation for Allah's existence before time?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) employs a dialectical method by asking Nafi’ ibn al-Azraq to define the beginning of time itself, thereby demonstrating that Allah’s existence precedes and transcends temporal measurement. This narration is foundational in Shia kalām for establishing Allah’s eternity (Azaliyyah) and independence from created categories like space and motion. It reinforces the concept of Divine Simplicity, asserting that God is not subject to the limitations of 'when' or 'where'.
